info.bio:
Blues Traveler es una Banda Americana formada en 1987 en  la ciudad de Priceton, New Jersey. Son Principalmente conocidos por sus seguidores por hits como "Run-Around", "Hook" y "But Anyway".

2007, El grupo esta compuesto por El cantante y virtuoso de la harmonica  John Popper, el guitarrista Chan Kinchla,  el baterista Brendan Hill, Bajista Tad Kinchla, y al piano Ben Wilson. Tad Kinchla y Ben Wilson entraron a formar parte de la banda tras la muerte del bajista original Bobby Sheehan in 1999

scenes.name: Sonidos progresivos de los noventa
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Phish devuelven el rock alternativo a la radio y legitiman el regreso a la estética progresiva, sobre todo en la Costa Este: Blues Traveler, Motherhead Bug y Sulfur, Spin Doctors, Klezmatics, Cul De Sac (Ecim, China Gate) y Run On. El noise-punk-jazz de God Is My Co-pilot, Molecules, Love Child, Blowhole, Harry Pussy. Virginia como epicentro (Echolyn, Boud Deun, Rake, Dave Matthews Band). Solistas: Marc Ribot, Nicky Skopelitis, Buckethead, Loren Mazzacane, los zappianos Ant-Bee y Mike Keneally, Gary Lucas, Alan Licht, Bob Drake. En la Costa Oeste, Primus (Frizzle Fry), Mr Bungle, Amy Denio, Caveman Shoestore, Thessalonians. Internacional: Philharmonie, Xaal, Volapuk, Kevin Martin (God, Techno Animal, Ice, Bug). Y la Babel final: Bright, Meringue, Cerberus Shoal, Tin Hat Trio, Species Being.

mentions.author: Piero Scaruffi
mentions.text: …a surrogate of the Grateful Dead for the 1990s. They legitimized a return to the aesthetics of progressive-rock, particularly on the East Coast. Blues Traveler were a simpler, domestic, rootsy version of Phish. Blues Traveler (1990) offered a judicious mixture of ballads and jams, and the band would eventually match and surpass Phish's commercial success. Motherhead Bug…

podcast.title: Another Roadside Attraction International Tourmate
podcast.body: Blues Traveler was an international act that toured with The Tragically Hip's Another Roadside Attraction festival in 1993, 1995, and 1997, alongside Canadian performers. "But they also brought along Midnight Oil, Blues Traveler, Matthew Sweet and Cheryl Crow."
